states.name: default
states.undrawn: No frame draws this page. It was added by evolve from the prose request 'add a changelog page' (design/deltas/2026-10-01-changelog-page/delta.md) and is built in the site's existing design language.

states.name: dark
states.undrawn: No frame draws this page. The dark theme is the capture's dark pass of the default story, as for Home.

screens.evidence: Prose request 'add a changelog page'; the landing names the page screens/Changelog (EvolveThread reply) and ChangelogMini draws it in miniature (Landing.dc.html:298-304).
screens.note: One route serves web-desktop (1440) and web-mobile (390). The page prints the repository's CHANGELOG.md, read at build time. It does not use SiteHeader, whose links are in-page anchors on Home; the lockup links home instead. Nothing on Home links to it (the footer link was left as it is at the E4 gate).

molecules.name: ReleaseEntry
molecules.undrawn: No frame draws a release at full size; ChangelogMini draws the row in miniature (a pill and a line). Added by evolve for the Changelog screen.
molecules.evidence: ChangelogMini rows (Landing.dc.html:301-303) set the pill rule: newest filled, older outlined. design/deltas/2026-10-01-changelog-page/delta.md.
molecules.note: One release: the version pill and date in the margin, then each group of changes (Added, Changed, Fixed, Removed) as a plate label over a bulleted list. Backticked runs in a change render as InlineCode.
